{"code": "
# Build the 10-record accuracy contract: on-chip organoid sensitivity (assay) vs patient clinical response (truth)
# Assay flags recorded visually from Supp Fig 11a heatmap / 11b,c curves (vision refs);
# truth from Supplementary Data 2 gray rows (response evaluation), mapped responder=1 / non-responder=0.

score_map = {"sensitive":1, "resistant":0}
truth_map_pd  = {"PD to PC":0, "PD to Afa":0, "PD":0, "PD to GC":0}
truth_map_rsp = {"non-PD":1, "PR to Gef":1, "PR to GC":1, "non-PD to Osi":1}

recs = [
 ("LC96+PC",   "vision/LC96+PC_assay",   "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I3",  truth_map_pd),
 ("LC132+Afa", "vision/LC132+Afa_assay", "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I4",  truth_map_pd),
 ("CRC1+Oxa",  "vision/CRC1+Oxa_assay",  "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/E5",  truth_map_pd),
 ("LC131+Gef", "vision/LC131+Gef_assay", "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I6",  truth_map_rsp),
 ("LC133+Gef", "vision/LC133+Gef_assay", "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I7",  truth_map_rsp),
 ("LC134+GC",  "vision/LC134+GC_assay",  "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I8",  truth_map_rsp),
 ("LC101+Gef", "vision/LC101+Gef_assay", "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I9",  truth_map_rsp),
 ("LC127+PC",  "vision/LC127+PC_assay",  "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I10", truth_map_pd),
 ("LC97+GC",   "vision/LC97+GC_assay",   "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/I14", truth_map_pd),
 ("LC137+EC",  "vision/LC137+EC_assay",  "supp.xlsx/Sheet1/E22", truth_map_pd),
]

records = []
for pid, sref, tref, tmap in recs:
    records.append({
        "id": pid,
        "score": {"ref": sref, "map": score_map},
        "truth": {"ref": tref, "map": tmap},
    })

# sanity check with the visual/label values
sv = {"LC96+PC":0,"LC132+Afa":0,"CRC1+Oxa":0,"LC131+Gef":1,"LC133+Gef":1,"LC134+GC":1,"LC101+Gef":1,"LC127+PC":0,"LC97+GC":0,"LC137+EC":0}
tv = {"LC96+PC":0,"LC132+Afa":0,"CRC1+Oxa":0,"LC131+Gef":1,"LC133+Gef":1,"LC134+GC":1,"LC101+Gef":1,"LC127+PC":0,"LC97+GC":0,"LC137+EC":0}
acc = sum(1 for k in sv if (sv[k]>=0.5)==(tv[k]>=0.5))/len(sv)
print("check accuracy:", acc, "n:", len(sv))
# contingency from Fig 11d: sensitive/responder=4, sens/nonresp=0, nonsens/resp=0, nonsens/nonresp=6 -> acc=(4+6)/10
print("contingency accuracy:", (4+6)/10.0)

CONTRACT = {
 "status":"computed",
 "fields":{
  "unit":{"value":"patient_regimen","evidence":["article:p27","supp.xlsx/Sheet1/A3"],"explanation":"Each record is one patient organoid line matched to the specific regimen the patient received and that was tested on-chip"},
  "platform":{"value":"microwell","evidence":["article:p16","article:p27"],"explanation":"1-week drug sensitivity tests performed on the integrated superhydrophobic microwell array chip (InSMAR-chip)"},
  "readout":{"value":"ic50","evidence":["41467_2021_22676_MOESM1_ESM.pdf/page13/R3C6","article:p20"],"explanation":"On-chip sensitivity classified from fitted dose-response curves (IC50 / AUC-DRC, log10(IC50) heat map in Supp Fig 11a)"},
  "direction":{"value":"lower_sensitive","evidence":["article:p20"],"explanation":"Lower IC50 / lower AUC-DRC indicates drug sensitivity"},
  "threshold_rule":{"value":"categorical","evidence":["41467_2021_22676_MOESM1_ESM.pdf/page13/R8C12"],"explanation":"Organoid calls are categorical sensitive vs non-sensitive vs patient responder vs non-responder (Supp Fig 11d); no numeric cutoff published"},
  "threshold_timing":{"value":"not_reported","evidence":["article:p27"],"explanation":"No cutoff fitting described; agreement tabulated directly"},
  "patient_mapping":{"value":"individual_available","evidence":["supp.xlsx/Sheet1/A3","supp.xlsx/Sheet1/A22"],"explanation":"Grey rows of Supplementary Data 2 list each evaluable patient ID with regimen and response evaluation"},
  "regimen_match":{"value":"matched","evidence":["article:p27","supp.xlsx/Sheet1/M3"],"explanation":"Only lines whose administered drug was tested by the on-chip assay are counted (10 of 21)"},
  "n_units":{"value":10,"evidence":["article:p27"],"explanation":"Ten organoid lines with evaluable, comparable patient responses"},
  "split":{"value":"none","evidence":["article:p27"],"explanation":"No training/discovery cohort; the 10 evaluated pairs are the whole comparison set"},
 },
 "headline":{
  "metric":"accuracy",
  "reported":1.0,
  "reported_evidence":["article:p27","article:p28","vision/contingency_sensitive_responder","vision/contingency_nonsensitive_nonresponder"],
  "threshold":0.5,
  "op":">=",
  "score_direction":"higher",
  "records":records,
  "blocked_reason":None
 },
 "notes":[
  "article:p27: in 10 of 21 organoid lines the 1-week on-chip results agreed with clinical data, 100% accuracy and specificity (Fisher's exact test P=0.0048).",
  "Supp Fig 11d contingency (4/0/0/6) gives accuracy (4+6)/10 = 1.0; vision labels carry per-cell uncertainty for heat-map colors.",
  "Score = on-chip sensitive(1)/resistant(0) from Supp Fig 11a-c; truth = patient responder(1: PR/CR/non-PD)/non-responder(0: PD) from Supplementary Data 2.",
  "CRC1 and LC137 clinical truth taken from 'Patient response to previous treatments' (PD) because their response-evaluation cell is N/A while the same agent class was tested on-chip.",
 ]
}
print("records:", len(records))
"}
